counting_rules: Font and font-size counts are non-empty text runs, not slides or characters.
Explicit font means font declaration on the run; inherited includes paragraph, shape, layout and master-text-style declarations. Theme references are resolved against each slide master.
Template inventories count a unique used master/layout once; referenced_slide_count gives its deck usage. Layer overlap, visibility and customer-specific logos require visual review.
Palette cells are counted only where direct cell properties contain a solidFill; inherited table-style cells are not invented.
Alpha values are recorded separately from RGB. Color counts do not imply semantic brand status.
